doc.title: Dianne Reeves interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, October 13, 2001

title: Thanks and closing
summary: Woods praises her gift and thanks her for visiting Hamilton College.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well listen I just want to, first of all I want to tell you I think you’re more than a great vocalist.

I think that your gift, the voice that you have, is a gift to people all over the world. Not that many people on this planet that will ever live and breathe on this planet will be able to sing like you do.
And I want to thank you immeasurably for bringing that skill to Hamilton College.
